ticker_news.title: S&P 500 Could Soar 12% By Year-End—But Only If Recession Is Avoided, Goldman Sachs Says
ticker_news.description: The S&P 500 could climb 12% to 6,200 by 2025 if the U.S. economy avoids a recession, according to Goldman Sachs. The 'Magnificent 7' tech firms are planning a 32% increase in capital expenditures, signaling confidence in AI and cloud growth.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari

ticker_news.title: 1 Wall Street Analyst Thinks Tesla Will Hit $425. Is it a Buy Around $235?
ticker_news.description: Tesla (TSLA) has faced a range of challenges, including negative headlines, plunging sales in Europe, and vandalism. However, the company is preparing to launch its robotaxi service in 2023, which could be a game-changer. Wall Street analysts are divided on the stock, with Cantor Fitzgerald upgrading it to overweight, while others have slashed earnings estimates.
ticker_news.author: Jeremy Bowman
